{{Quote|Rebel forces! This is General Vitsun Weiss of the Imperial Army. You are surrounded and severely outgunned. Surrender and I swear mercy shall be granted!|Vitsun Weiss|<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Assault Core Set" />}}
'''Vitsun Weiss''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[General/Legends|general]] active during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A [[Field Commander/Legends|field commander]], he often operated a heavily customized [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST walker]].<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Assault Core Set" />

==Biography==
[[File:General_Weiss_alt_card_IA.png|thumb|left|180px|Weiss's customized AT-ST]]
At some point during the Galactic Civil War, Weiss and his forces proceeded to raid a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]]-owned encampment on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. His forces successfully managed to capture several Rebel soldiers, although not before the Rebels hid key supplies within the camp.

==Personality and traits==
Being an Imperial general and field commander, Weiss was dedicated to upholding order within the Galactic Empire, and frequently operated a heavily customized AT-ST walker. He also possessed a keen military mind, and was capable of deploying his forces to either charge the enemy or otherwise complete certain objectives while he himself focuses his firepower on any Rebel soldiers.

==Behind the scenes==
Vitsun Weiss is a character that was introduced in the starter set of the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] tactical miniatures [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]''.
